findings.text: the done-when proves only the state-mode path: all three tests (undeclared-heading refusal, declaration-without-heading refusal, and the insert_section acceptance) run through state-mode writes, yet the deliverable (lines 122-124) requires the same check on the text path, and the text path is the one that runs today with no such check — `_replace_plan_text` (`reckon/_store.py:1808`) never calls `_require_heading_for_section_records`. A build that wires the widened check into `_write_state_locked` only satisfies every stated test while the text path stays unguarded, so the requirement it names is unverified.
